title: RPE forced-only fourth-order EDMDc

method.normalization: Mean and standard deviation of forced X snapshots, frozen for evaluation
method.training_policy: Active sinusoidal-drive intervals only. Excludes warmup and ringdown. No unforced records, derivatives, or prior eigenfunctions.
method.selection: Positive-frequency oscillatory mode nearest one cycle per nondimensional time unit

plot.renderer: Native Viewer PlotCanvas and shared Koopman polynomial evaluation
plot.note: Display zoom only; all active forced data used in fitting. Colored rectangle includes unsampled points and does not certify validity throughout the rectangle.

limitations: Eigenfunction of the fitted A operator, not a certified eigenfunction of the true unforced RPE flow.
Constant additive input matrix in polynomial feature space is approximate; the broad nonlinear sine bank is not accurately represented by this fit.
No unforced validation, control attempt, or discrete-to-continuous input conversion performed.
Only standalone case clients added; core pipeline unchanged. Large archives and graphics remain local and ignored by Git.
